s.t:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide.
Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2 .
Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. We’re a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agrees– our employee NPS is in the high 80s.

As a Sales Development Representative, your primary responsibility will be to secure meetings with top prospective companies and individuals. You'll work closely with one paired Account Executive to generate meetings from their target account list.

We encourage account development through outbound prospecting, social selling, networking, attending conferences and field marketing events, and any sales activity that would contribute to expanding the Tremendous brand.

You will be the first line of engagement with prospective customers and will have an impact on Tremendous’ revenue growth and future success.

Work primarily to bring in new deals through Outbound prospecting.
Collaborate with Account Executives, as well as members of our Marketing and Customer Success teams, to develop new strategies to build our sales pipeline and grow our business.
Use Amplemarket, LinkedIn, your own network, and other prospecting tools to research accounts, identify key contacts and craft targeted messaging.
Learn our technology and effectively communicate our value proposition. Work to understand their goals and challenges to better understand how we can help.

1-3 years of prior sales experience, ideally in a similar outbound or SDR role.
Clever and creative problem solving. We're small and emphasize output and iteration over a sales handbook set in stone.
Independence. We all work together to solve tough problems here at Tremendous, but taking pride in experimenting and finding your own answers is the best way to learn.
Collaboration. When our SDRs uncover new trends and tactics that work to set meetings, they share them with their teammates so everyone can benefit.
Ability to thrive with a well-set quota. We want our goals to be fair and achievable. You should find these goals alongside your team and with your manager and use them as a benchmark for success.
Ambition. Ambition isn't a dirty word at Tremendous. We're a team of achievers collaborating on a fast-growing product and that means personal growth in both role and responsibility as well as tons of personal upside for you.

You'll work at a company growing quickly yet sustainably. We’re profitable with plenty more opportunity ahead. That’s good news for your career growth.
Competitive pay and equity. Base salary for this role: $65,000 - $70,000 plus commission.
Real benefits. 100% covered health (US), unlimited PTO, 12-16 weeks paid parental leave.
Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook .
Location
This role is remote-first and you can work wherever you want in the Americas.

Zelh is a fast-growing outsourcing company that partners with leading US logistics organizations.
Our mission is to become the most reliable outsourcing partner by delivering consistently high-quality services while building long-term relationships with our clients, employees, and partners. We believe that personal attention, timely communication, continuous improvement, and respect are the foundation of everything we do.
We are looking for a proactive Carrier Sales Representative to support our growing drayage operation. This position is responsible for sourcing, developing, and maintaining relationships with drayage motor carriers throughout the United States while securing competitive capacity for customer shipments.

The Drayage Carrier Sales Representative plays a critical role throughout the shipment lifecycle - from quoting and carrier selection through dispatch, scheduling, execution, accessorial management, and final carrier charge verification.

Source and develop reliable drayage carriers across major U.S. port and rail markets.
Build and maintain strong carrier relationships with dispatchers, owners, and carrier representatives.
Identify carrier capacity by proactively contacting carriers about equipment availability, lane preferences, and market conditions.
Request and negotiate rates for drayage shipments, including linehaul and accessorial charges, while protecting company margins.
Evaluate and select carriers based on pricing, availability, equipment, reliability, and service history.
Secure capacity and cover loads after customer approval, ensuring carriers can meet required pickup and delivery dates.
Coordinate pickup and delivery schedules, including container pulls, appointments, container availability, and Last Free Day (LFD) requirements.
Monitor shipment execution and resolve issues, including carrier delays, appointment problems, equipment shortages, and container availability.
Manage accessorial charges, such as detention, storage, chassis, waiting time, redelivery, and demurrage-related costs, ensuring proper approval and documentation.
Complete shipment closeout, including verifying final carrier charges, collecting required documentation, updating TAI, and ensuring accurate records.

Proven experience negotiating carrier rates, securing truck capacity, and working with TMS platforms.
Ability to manage multiple shipments, quotes, carriers, and deadlines simultaneously.

At GAF Commercial we cover more than buildings. We cover each other. No matter what role, tenure, or department, under this roof you are helping to build the market leader in commercial roofing. Becoming the market leader only happens when everyone feels they have the opportunity, and the support, to thrive. We are GAF . And under this roof, we protect what matters most.

The Commercial GTM Sales Representative acts as the high-velocity orchestration engine for the closing half of the commercial roofing sales cycle.

Operating at a geographical Area Manager level, this role functions as a strategic, data-driven partner to the field, turning qualified intelligence into coordinated action.Upon formal hand-off from the GTM Sales Analyst and entry into Salesforce, the GTM Sales Rep takes full operational command of the project lifecycle.

Shifting focus away from early-stage prospecting, this role centers entirely on the critical deal-execution phase.

As the primary driver for late-stage success, you will oversee the complex flow of inbound project demands and steer field representatives toward high-priority targets. By orchestrating bid meetings and performing rigorous win/loss analytics, you provide the vital market intelligence needed to accelerate regional revenue and identify key growth opportunities in emerging strategy markets.

Handoff Orchestration & Nurture Cadence
· Formally take ownership of projects and qualified leads once they are logged in Salesforce by the GTM Sales Analyst, initiating a tight, collaborative strategy with field reps.
· Actively monitor the area funnel to identify "stuck" projects. Work directly with field reps to provide the necessary technical data, submittals, or incentives to nudge the contractor or owner to a "yes."
· Turn top-funnel data into precise field execution, maintaining a rigorous follow-up cadence so multi-month construction timelines are never missed.
Bid and Quoting Coordination
· Facilitate, track, and manage the execution of Buying Agreements, ensuring they align with regional pricing boundaries and margin targets.
· Monitor and report on how effectively our customers are leveraging BAs. Evaluate whether current price points and packaging strategies are accelerating or hindering overall sales velocity.
· Coordinate and track critical project pre-bid and bid-day meetings. Ensure field reps, contractors, and estimating teams are perfectly aligned and equipped with the necessary project data and documents.
· Establish a continuous feedback loop following bid meetings to gather real-time market intelligence regarding competitor positioning and pricing strategies.
Win/Loss Analysis & Post-Project Insights
· Conduct thorough "autopsies" on pipeline outcomes to pinpoint why we won or lost (e.g., price, spec break, contractor preference) and translate findings into actionable data.
· Collaborate with sales and support teams to ensure won accounts deliver sustainable, high-quality revenue over the long term.
· Report win/loss trends back to Product, Pricing, and GTM strategy teams to adjust upstream messaging and product development.
· Act as the gatekeeper for Salesforce data accuracy during the closing stages, ensuring regional pipeline forecasting is reliable and accurate.
Enablement, Coaching & Alignment
· Provide real-time feedback and alignment to the sales team on objection handling, ensuring reps are actively and correctly using the latest competitive "Battle Cards."
· Assist in training and mentoring new sales hires to compress their time-to-quota and keep existing reps sharp on GTM processes.
· Maintain and curate a ready-to-go library of case studies, white papers, and technical one-pagers for immediate field deployment.

About Revelo
Revelo provides top quality tech talent from Latin American countries to US and Canadian companies hiring remotely.
We are a tech first company that uses our technology to source, match and allocate remote digital workers faster, cheaper and more accurately than competitors. We are in the middle of the biggest shift to remote work that the world has ever seen - come be a part of it!
With large amounts of capital being injected into Brazil and Latin America over the previous 15 years from both national and international venture capital and capital equity, there has been a significant increase in the education of professionals and adolescents with skills in all aspects of technology (software development, data science, product development, product management, crypto, and so forth).

This rapid growth of maturing companies has made Latin America a key producer of high caliber tech talent. The pandemic opened the eyes of North American companies to the opportunity of accessing that talent for a new pool of candidates beyond the saturated and more competitive markets they’re used to recruiting in.
Born in 2015 out of São Paulo, over the course of 8 years we’ve gained vast expertise in sourcing, recruiting and placing tech talent throughout Latin America. We’re now able to share that knowledge and help companies connect to the right talent to build their technology.

Als Account Executive (x/f/m) im Vertriebsgebiet Dreieck Leverkusen, Wuppertal und Gummersbach (rechtsrheinisch) führst Du Dein Territory wie ein eigenes Business und bringst mit unserer KI-gestützten All-in-One-Lösung echten Mehrwert direkt in den Praxisalltag.
Du gewinnst neue Zahnarztpraxen für Doctolib und begleitest sie auf dem Weg zu einer effizienteren, digitaleren Organisation. Die Chance, die vor uns liegt, ist noch weit größer als das, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben.
Deine Aufgaben
Outbound und Inbound Sales: Du kombinierst die aktive Ansprache potenzieller Kund:innen über bereitgestellte Leads, telefonisch und vor Ort, mit der Bearbeitung eingehender Inbound-Anfragen. Dein Ziel ist es, qualifizierte Ersttermine zu vereinbaren und neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu entwickeln.
Erste Verkaufsgespräche und Bedarfsermittlung: Du führst erste Gespräche mit Zahnärzt:innen und Praxisteams, verstehst ihre Herausforderungen und identifizierst ihren individuellen Bedarf.
Full-Cycle-Sales: Du verantwortest den gesamten Sales Cycle, von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme über die Bedarfsermittlung, Produktpräsentation und Verhandlung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss.
Pipeline, Umsatz und Wachstum: Du baust Deine Pipeline eigenständig auf und verantwortest die Entwicklung Deines Vertriebsgebiets.
Kundenzentrierte Beratung: Du zeigst potenziellen Kund:innen den konkreten Mehrwert unserer digitalen HealthTech-Lösung für ihren Praxisalltag.
Datengetriebene Erfolgsmessung: Du trackst Deine Performance regelmäßig mit Salesforce und nutzt Daten für eine gezielte Vertriebsstrategie.
Strukturierte Übergabe nach Vertragsabschluss: Nach dem Abschluss übergibst Du Deine neuen Kund:innen strukturiert an unser Projektmanagement-Team. Dort werden sie anschließend vollständig betreut und bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung begleitet.
Die Position ist vollständig auf die Gewinnung neuer Kund:innen ausgerichtet. Eine laufende Bestandskundenbetreuung gehört nicht zu Deinen Aufgaben.

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die oder der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen.

Proaktivität und Akquise-Talent: Du hast bereits eigenständig Pipeline aufgebaut und neue Kund:innen gewonnen
Beratungsstärke: Du kannst erklärungsbedürftige Produkte oder Dienstleistungen verständlich und kundenzentriert vermitteln
Energie und Überzeugungskraft: Du trittst sicher und professionell auf, verkaufst mit Leidenschaft und lässt Dich auch von Rückschlägen nicht entmutigen
Entrepreneurial Mindset: Du bist ergebnisorientiert, gut organisiert und behältst auch bei Herausforderungen den Fokus
Kommunikation auf Top-Niveau: Du kannst Dich sehr gut mündlich und schriftlich auf Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder höher ausdrücken
Internationale Kompetenz: Für interne Trainings, All-Hands und die Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Kolleg:innen sind Englischkenntnisse hilfreich, aber keine Voraussetzung

Flexibilität und Mobilität: Dein Vertriebsalltag findet dort statt, wo es zählt, direkt bei Zahnärzt:innen vor Ort. Ein Führerschein der Klasse B wird vorausgesetzt

About Wayflyer
Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.
Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.
You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.
The challenge
We've deployed over $6bn to small businesses that traditional banks were too slow, too rigid, or too disinterested to back. Now we're growing fast, and we need a world-class sales team to continue the momentum, finding the founders who need us before they know we exist.
What you'll actually do
You'll be the first voice a lot of founders ever hear from Wayflyer. That matters. Your job is to cut through the noise - smart outreach, real conversations, and get the right businesses in front of our Account Executives. You'll qualify funding needs, build genuine rapport with founders, and figure out pretty quickly that the best reps here aren't order-takers. They're curious, they hustle, and they care about getting it right.
What this role could turn into
We'll be honest -this isn't a role we're hiring you to stay in forever. It's a launchpad. Most BDRs move into Account Executive or Customer Success roles within 12–18 months, and we plan for it actively through our Revenue Academy - a structured programme that builds the skills, deal exposure, and commercial fluency you need before you ever step into your next seat. Your manager isn't just hitting you with pipeline reviews; they're invested in where you want to go and what it takes to get there.
We're building careers here, not just filling headcount. The people who thrive with us are the ones who are hungry to grow - and we take it as our responsibility to make sure the path is there when they are.
Who thrives here
You've worked in a target-driven environment before and you didn't just survive it, you wanted more. You're the kind of person who reads a rejection email and immediately thinks about what to try differently. You spot problems outside your lane and you can't help yourself. You'll probably end up doing things that aren't in this job description. That's not a warning, it's the point.
We hire for range
We care more about trajectory than tenure. Relevant sales experience is important, but what we're really looking for beyond that is someone who's hungry, commercially sharp, and genuinely excited by the challenge. Fluent English is a must. Startup experience is a bonus, not a requirement.
Location and working policy
📍 Sydney, hybrid (3-4 days per week in the office)
The good stuff
25 days off, plus public holidays. Private healthcare, life insurance, and pension. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.

## **Was erwartet dich?** ##
Die Raiffeisenbank Regio Laufenburg steht für persönliche Kundennähe, unternehmerisches Handeln und ein familiäres Arbeitsumfeld. Als eigenständige Bank setzen wir auf kurze Wege, Eigenverantwortung und Mitarbeitende, die mit ihren Ideen und ihrem Engagement unsere Zukunft aktiv mitprägen.
Als Kredit- und Hypothekarberater/in übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in der Beratung und Betreuung unserer Kunden:
* **Du findest Finanzierungslösungen, die überzeugen.** Gemeinsam mit unseren Privat- und Firmenkunden entwickelst du passgenaue Konzepte für ihre Vorhaben und Ziele.
* **Du berätst mit Kompetenz und Weitblick.** In den Bereichen Finanzieren, Vorsorge, Absicherung, Pensionierung und Steuern begleitest du unsere Kunden persönlich und vorausschauend.
* **Du baust Beziehungen auf, die Bestand haben.** Mit einer aktiven und nachhaltigen Betreuung erkennst du Potenziale und entwickelst dein Kundenportefeuille kontinuierlich weiter.
* **Du gewinnst Vertrauen und neue Kundschaft.** Mit deinem Gespür für Menschen und einem professionellen Auftritt begeisterst du unsere bestehenden Kunden und gewinnst neue Kunden für unsere Bank.
* **Du bringst dich aktiv ein und gestaltest unseren Markterfolg mit.** Bei Kampagnen und Marktbearbeitungsmassnahmen wirkst du aktiv mit und sorgst für eine starke Präsenz in unserer Region.
* **Dein Einsatz macht den Unterschied.** Bei uns zählt jeder Beitrag. Du übernimmst Verantwortung, bringst dich aktiv ein und gestaltest die Zukunft unserer Bank mit.
## **Was bringst du mit?** ##
* **Du bringst das Bankfach mit.** Eine abgeschlossene Bankausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung bildet die Grundlage für deinen Erfolg in dieser Funktion.
* **Du berätst sicher und kompetent.** Deine langjährige Erfahrung in der Hypothekarberatung und deine Kenntnisse im Firmenkundengeschäft macht dich zur idealen Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden.
* **Du handelst eigenverantwortlich und zielgerichtet.** Eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise sowie Freude am Verkauf und an der Gewinnung neuer Kundinnen und Kunden zeichnen dich aus.
* **Du stellst die Kunden in den Mittelpunkt.** Mit deiner ausgeprägten Serviceorientierung schaffst du Vertrauen und begeisternde Kundenerlebnisse.
* **Du ziehst mit dem Team am gleichen Strang.** Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Eigeninitiative und Teamgeist prägen deine Arbeitsweise.
* **Du gehst Herausforderungen mit Energie an.** Flexibilität, Leistungsbereitschaft und eine positive Einstellung zeichnen dich aus.

The SDR, Strategic Accounts is responsible for generating new business opportunities across both prospective and existing customer accounts. The role focuses on strategic account development, identifying high-value opportunities within complex organizations and creating meaningful engagement with the right stakeholders.
For prospective accounts , the SDR owns outbound prospecting efforts to identify and create new opportunities within high-priority strategic accounts. This includes researching accounts, identifying key stakeholders and buying groups, leveraging intent and account signals, and developing personalized outreach that creates meaningful sales conversations.
For customer accounts , the focus shifts toward expansion . The SDR partners closely with Account Directors and other customer-facing teams to identify whitespace, new teams or business units, additional use cases, and other signals that may indicate an opportunity for growth. The SDR helps create new relationships within existing customers and generates qualified expansion opportunities for the account team.
Across both motions, the SDR is expected to take an account-based approach rather than simply prospecting individual contacts. This means understanding the broader organization, mapping relevant stakeholders, identifying business priorities and potential use cases, and coordinating outreach across multiple personas where appropriate.
The role also supports strategic account planning by surfacing relevant insights, engagement signals, and prospect intelligence that can help Account Directors prioritize where to focus their efforts.

SailPoint is the leader in Identity Security. SailPoint customers represent half of the Fortune 500 and half of the ASX 50. This customer strength provides us with a great community of customers, partners and analysts who trust SailPoint and our team to solve complex challenges. The rapid adoption of AI and agent-based systems is driving an explosion of non-human identities — including agents, bots, service accounts, and APIs — operating at a scale and speed traditional identity models were not built to govern.
As organisations look to operationalise AI, identity is emerging as the control plane that determines what these entities can access, what actions they can take, and how they interact across systems.
The Advanced Technology Specialist (ATS) plays a critical role in helping customers define this new model — enabling faster AI adoption while ensuring appropriate governance across both human and non-human identities.
We are proud of our team and the culture we have built which has led to our employees voting us “best places to work” – 15 years in a row.

About Betterment
Betterment is a leading, technology-driven financial services company that offers investing, savings and retirement solutions for retail investors and investment advisors as well as financial wellness solutions, including a 401(k) for small and medium-sized businesses.

Our team is passionate about our mission, to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease. We’re headquartered in NYC and offer hybrid NY-based positions (four days/ week in-office, with no required office days during the summer and winter holidays).

We're hiring ambitious, tech-savvy Business Development Representatives to join one of three teams driving top-of-funnel growth across Betterment's retirement and advisor solutions businesses:
Direct 401(k) BDR — builds pipeline with small and mid-sized businesses looking to launch or switch their 401(k) plan.
Advised 401(k) BDR — builds pipeline with financial advisors and RIAs looking to offer or improve 401(k) plans for their business-owner clients.
Custody BDR — builds pipeline with independent RIAs evaluating or switching custodians for Betterment Advisor Solutions (BAS).
In each of these roles, you'll own outbound prospecting at the top of the sales funnel — an activity-heavy role where you'll identify, engage, and qualify prospects before handing off warm opportunities to Account Executives. You're a self-starter who's comfortable with high call/email volume, quick to learn a technical product, and motivated by hitting (and beating) targets.
Candidates will be considered for the team(s) whose current hiring needs best match their background and interests; the specific team will be confirmed during the interview process.

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
We’re here to give power to the patient.
For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Founding Sales Development Representative (SDR) — AI & Zero Trust Security
Remote (US) · ET or CT time zone · [$60,000 base / $90,000 OTE] + equity
The short version: NetFoundry , the company behind OpenZiti, the world’s most used open source Zero Trust networking software, is hiring two founding SDRs to build NetFoundry 's outbound engine. This is a hunter role selling Zero Trust connectivity into cybersecurity, cloud, and AI infrastructure teams. If you want to build the playbook instead of inheriting one and have ambition to become an AE, keep reading.

AI broke the network security model.
Agents, models, and APIs now need to reach data and systems scattered across clouds, data centers, edge sites, and customer environments. Every one of those connections is a new attack surface. VPNs, open inbound ports, and firewall rules were never designed for a world where the thing requesting access is a non-human identity that spun up four seconds ago.
NetFoundry replaces that model. Our Identity-First Connectivity™ platform delivers Zero Trust connectivity with no VPNs, no open inbound ports, and no firewall changes enabling enterprises to connect AI agents, APIs, and distributed workloads without exposing anything to the internet.
Enterprises use us to secure access to their APIs and agentic AI services, to run microsegmentation, and to simplify hybrid IT/OT segmentation. Software and IoT providers use us to reach workloads inside their customers' networks.
We were founded by the inventors and maintainers of OpenZiti, the world's most-used open source Zero Trust networking software. We're Series A, backed by SYN Ventures and Cisco Investments, headquartered in Charlotte, NC, and remote-first since day one.

We have one SDR today. We're hiring two more, and we're building the enterprise go-to-market motion around you.
That means the target account strategy, the sequences, the call openers, the objection handling, the way we mine our open source community for enterprise signal - isn't fully developed yet. You'll contribute to it working directly with our AEs, our marketing team, and GTM leadership that has built and exited multiple startups.
This is the right role if you want to be early. It's the wrong role if you want a machine that already runs.
A note on leads: This is an outbound focused role. Marketing supports you with content, campaigns, and intent data. Pieline starts with you, on the phone.

Own outbound pipeline generation into a defined set of enterprise accounts — you build the list, you work the list
Cold call. Daily. This is the core of the job, not a footnote
Run multi-channel outbound across phone, email, and LinkedIn, with real personalization rather than merge fields
Run discovery that surfaces real pain: firewall and VPN sprawl, exposed APIs, OT segmentation projects, AI agents that need access to sensitive systems
Book qualified meetings for Account Executives and hit monthly and quarterly pipeline targets
Build account plans with AEs and multi-thread into security, networking, cloud, and platform teams
Act as our fastest feedback loop since you'll hear what the market says before anyone else. Leadership will change the messaging based on what you report.

Ambition to become an AE
1–3 years in outbound SDR/BDR or inside sales, ideally in cybersecurity, SaaS, or enterprise technology
A track record you can put numbers to - activity, meetings booked, pipeline sourced, quota attainment
Genuine willingness to cold call, and the resilience to do it on the days it isn't working

Field-Based Business Development Representative , Limerick & Galway
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide.

From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.
We’re looking for a Field-Based Business Development Representative to join our Limerick & Galway team. In this role, you’ll help us sign up the best restaurants across Limerick, Galway and the West Ireland region, improving our proposition for customers and identifying ways to continue our fast growth.
Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.
What You’ll Be Doing
You’ll be joining the Regional UK & Ireland team, reporting to the Regional Manager. We are experts in the local markets we serve, and this role is all about being out on the road, finding hidden gems, and being the face of Deliveroo in the West and Ireland.

s.h: Here’s what your day-to-day might look like
s.t:
Strategic Prospecting: Map, prospect, pitch, and close new restaurants across your region, acting as a city-level expert who knows exactly which up-and-coming spots customers crave most.
Multi-channel Outreach: Communicate with restaurant owners through physical visits, calls, and digital platforms to demonstrate the value of Deliveroo’s technology.
Seamless Onboarding: Oversee the partner onboarding process from start to finish to ensure it is as quick, efficient, and seamless as possible.
Performance Monitoring: Ensure restaurant success within the critical first eight weeks of signing to guarantee long-term growth on the platform.
Community Immersion: Attend restaurant and food meet-ups and sample food from high-quality establishments to stay ahead of market trends.
What You’ll Need to Thrive
Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
Sales & Negotiation: Proven experience in targeting new business and the ability to structure win-win deals for both partners and Deliveroo.
Commercial Knowledge: A strong understanding of the economics of food delivery and the ability to work effectively towards demanding monthly targets.
Exceptional Communication: Confidence in building relationships face-to-face, over the phone, and via email with a wide range of stakeholders.
Operational Ownership: A tenacious, self-motivated approach to managing your own territory and taking full ownership of your results.
Mobility: A valid driving licence and access to a car are required, as you will be frequently travelling across Limerick & Galway and the surrounding areas.

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.

Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital.

Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will focus on three core missions. One, you will help our users and prospects navigate their Grafana journey by engaging with and listening to them in order to provide them with appropriate resources and guidance.

Two, with these learnings, you will partner with our Sales Team to connect with other influential people in these organizations to identify new business opportunities that are the pipeline for our company’s revenue goals by partnering proactively with our Sales Team.

And three, you will develop valuable, transferable skills to help you achieve your career goals. By fulfilling our three core missions, you will contribute importantly to Grafana Labs’ community and business goals.
We understand that our commercial success is linked to our open source DNA and users’ success with our software. As such, we want team members who can effectively leverage this connection and help support the long-term health of our company.
In this role, you will balance reactive and proactive work, responding to inbound inquiries as well as outreaching to target accounts. You will need to research and have a detective mindset in order to craft thoughtful, value-add messaging; and you’ll need to be confident driving business conversations on the phone. You will need to know how to use AI as a tool to constantly improve your productivity.
This is a demanding and rewarding role. It is a fast-paced and challenging environment. While our company is growing sustainably, we still have a lot of building and improving to do. And we do this work together with our teammates from more than 15 different countries.

We're looking for driven, humble, technically curious people who embrace a team-first attitude and demonstrate extreme ownership. This is a great team to join, whether you’re just starting your career or looking to pivot into the tech industry.

You’ll have managers and teammates that care deeply about you as a professional and human, and you will learn more than you thought possible.

Build and maintain knowledge of our technology, competitors, open source ecosystem, and industry trends

Let’s be honest - interviewing is not easy. However, we want you to come prepared and succeed. When we interview, we’re trying to determine a couple of things:
Would you be successful if you were part of our team?
Will you love working here and be a positive influence on your fellow colleagues?
Will you grow professionally and personally during your time here?
We’re looking for people who are curious and passionate about technology, so make sure you invest some time in learning about Grafana Labs. Explore our community, the industry we operate in, what we offer, and how we set ourselves apart.
During your interview, you’ll be sharing stories about your current and past roles and experiences. The best way to frame this is with the CARR model: Context, Action, Results, Reflection. This allows you to succinctly share the experiences you’ve gained.
Remember, humility drives learning and we love working with people who are always trying to better themselves. Throughout our interview process, you will receive feedback, and usually directly in the interview. As you move through the interview process, make sure you listen to the feedback you receive and figure out how to incorporate the advice in the next step of the interview.

Twilio’s Self-Service Business, serves more than 300,000 active customers and generates nearly $1B annually. Strong communication skills with the ability to engage technical and business stakeholders.

About Concurrence
At Concurrence, we're building the clinical AI infrastructure that health systems, life sciences companies, payors, and government agencies run their patient-facing care on. Our agents work across the whole patient journey: pre-visit intake, care navigation, post-visit care plans, and ongoing monitoring. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time.
This hasn’t been solved because the underlying record was never built for it. EHRs were designed for billing, not for systems that learn. So instead of layering another point solution on top, we’re rebuilding the medical record as a timeline of clinical events and running agents on top of it that improve with every patient interaction.

Unlike single-purpose chatbots or scribes, Concurrence is the platform our customers use to build their own agents. That means our work has to hold up across specialties, workflows, and regulatory environments and not just one narrow use case.
Our agents have supported more than 10 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. Our work is validated through partnerships with leading academic medical institutions. We’re fresh off our Series A, backed by Tier 1 VCs such as Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures.
We’re a small team of around 35 people, working in person in New York City and San Francisco. We care deeply about craft, clinical rigor, and the speed at which good ideas reach patients. If you want your work to be measured in outcomes rather than releases, we’d like to hear from you.

Our Core Values
Patients Win, We Win
If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it.
High Standards, High Care
We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas—not despite our standards, but because of them.
Thoughtful Urgency
We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both.
Intensely Measured
We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it.
Who Builds With Us
Low ego: Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them.
Direct: You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided.
High agency: You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else.
Bar of excellence: You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same.
Skeptical: You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place.

Flex is a growth-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is creating the best rent payment experience. It’s hard to believe that it’s 2026 and paying rent on time is expensive, inflexible, and difficult. We’re here to change that! Flex enables our users to pay rent throughout the month on a schedule that better fits their finances and budget.

Our mission is to empower as many renters as possible with flexibility over their most significant recurring expense. After deliberately keeping a stealth profile as we built up unprecedented investor support and an enthusiastic user base, we are looking for motivated individuals to help us keep our mission growing. Will you be a part of the team?

Flex is on a mission to change the way bills get paid, starting with rent. We give renters more flexibility and control over one of their biggest monthly expenses, and we give the property management companies we partner with a modern, easy way to offer that flexibility to their residents. As we grow, we're looking for our next SDR to help bring more Property Management Companies into the Flex family.
This is a foundational role on a high-performing sales team, and it's designed to be the start of a real career, not just a first job. You'll be on the front lines building the pipeline that fuels our growth — and you'll be developed deliberately from day one through the Flex Sales Onboarding & Enablement, not just thrown into the deep end.
Where you'll work: This role is hybrid out of our Salt Lake City office (Lehi, UT), and you'll be in with the team 3 days a week. We're big believers that some of the best coaching, energy, and deals happen in person (and honestly, the team is pretty fun to be around). As a bonus, you'll get a Grubhub credit for lunch on the days you're in the office.
Where you'll travel: Beyond SLC, you'll get out of the office for company offsites in Mexico and our Sales Kickoff in Florida as well as onboarding in NYC , both built for big wins, big energy, and time to connect with the team outside the day to day grind.

Win new client relationships, driving revenue and market share across the rental real estate space.
Manage a robust pipeline in our CRM, keeping it sharp and up to date.
Tailor creative prospecting approaches for different personas across each business you target.
Establish relationships with senior executives and decision-makers through smart, persistent outbound efforts.
Follow up quickly and efficiently on every inbound lead you receive.
Educate prospective customers on how Flex helps property management companies offer their residents real financial flexibility.
Collaborate with our Accounts team to shape strategic adoption plans for new customers.
Take initiative, jumping into ad-hoc projects across the sales org.
You Could Be a Great Fit If
You're a self-starter who's genuinely hungry for success.
You have excellent written and verbal communication skills — you know how to make someone want to keep talking to you.
You build relationships with middle management and ownership quickly and authentically.
You move fast, stay flexible, and don't need everything mapped out to get started.
You thrive both working independently and collaborating with a team.
How We Set You Up
A structured first 90 days — foundational training, tool ramp, and your first certifications, building toward your first real production.
Hands-on certifications, not just training modules — you'll prove you can actually do the work, evaluated against a clear, consistent standard every SDR is held to.
An assigned AE mentor and a manager who coaches you weekly, not just at review time.
Ongoing enablement long after ramp ends — monthly development themes, team-wide visibility into what's working, and campaigns focused on where the market is moving.
A real, defined path forward — promotion to SDR II is earned through clear, objective criteria, and from there, real tracks into Account Executive or Account Management roles.
Why Flex
Strong onboarding, built to set you up for real success — we invest in ramping you right, not just throwing you into the deep end
Revenue enablement that never stops — ongoing coaching and resources designed to sharpen your skills long after ramp is over
Mentorship, built in — you'll learn directly from peers and senior sales folks who want to see you win, not just hit your own number
A real career path — this is a role to grow in , not just grow out of
A team that's winning — you'll be surrounded by top performers who are closing deals and hitting numbers, with the energy and momentum that comes from being part of a team that's actually putting up results
